title: Duckily Optimized
description: Lightweight, fast, classic. Just a tiny makeover to optimize you client.
body:
[**[PATREON]**](https://www.patreon.com/c/SamInJungle8) [**[DISCORD]**](https://discord.gg/VXD8XVNmc9)

A Lightweight modpack to optimize and make the game look better.
![Simple show of Duckily Optimized using Sodium to optimize](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0496c6c2716b9636cb70041bcf18955046d6cc15.jpeg)

# - Performance
Duckily Optimized is faster than normal vanilla Minecraft and competing optimization modpacks. The mods have been selected by careful testing and intensive thinking.

# - Like Optifine
Duckily Optimized has the most features of the classic Optifine like: shaders, connected textures and zoom. If the resource pack states: "OptiFine required," it will probably function here as well.

# - Feels familiar
There's no big texture changes. Because of that you can still experience that vanilla Minecraft fell. That mean you can: play with your friends, join vanilla servers, play singleplayer.

# - Connectivity
You can connect: controllers, steering wheels and other strange controller that normally doesn't connect to vanilla Minecraft.

# - Up to date
Duckily Optimized recieves new version and bug fix updates almost immediately that means you can always play Realms, join the latest servers and enjoy the latest Minecraft updates.

# - Built on NeoForge
NeoForge is Lightweight, fast, and always up to date. That means you can always add your favorite mods to the modpack.

# - Open source
Duckily Optimized is an open-development modpack, and so is all the mods in it, so if you have any mod suggestions or if something's not working - We welcome user suggestions and collaborate with mod developers to create a better user experience for everyone. You can do that in our GitHub page.
